item.description: It’s official: Geely Motor Philippines is launching the Monjaro EM-I this October. Drawing inspiration from Africa’s highest peak, Mount Kilimanjaro, the Monjaro EM-i is positioned as the brand’s executive performance flagship. Read More »

item.title: HARI Celebrates 25th Anniversary With Volvo Aftersales Offers
item.description: Hariphil Asia Resources Inc. (HARI), the exclusive distributor of Volvo Cars in the Philippines, marks its 25th Anniversary in the Philippine automotive industry by extending the celebration to Volvo owners through the exclusive Volvo Legacy Package, available from September 7 to November 30, 2026.
